headline: Nasdaq Falls as Alphabet Faces Record Loss Amid AI Spending Concerns
summary: The Nasdaq declined as Alphabet headed for a record loss amid growing investor concerns over soaring artificial intelligence capital expenditures.
why: Alphabet and major tech constituents drive broader index movements; shifts in their valuations directly impact technology-heavy benchmarks like the Nasdaq.

impacts.name: Alphabet Inc
impacts.why: Heavy capital expenditure guidance and market worries regarding AI monetization can trigger sharp equity sell-offs.

why_moved: Heavy investor scrutiny regarding the return on investment for artificial intelligence infrastructure spending pressured mega-cap tech valuations, dragging down the broader index.
